expo.name: Fabricator
expo.description: A mobile build memory system for tracking shop projects, tasks, parts, photos, costs, notes, and timeline history.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fabricator uses the camera to document build progress.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fabricator uses your photo library so you can attach existing build photos to projects.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Fabricator uses the microphone for garage voice notes.
